summary: Configured a persistent, restricted SSH tunnel from node2:127.0.0.1:9082 to node1:127.0.0.1:9081. Automatic reconnection, listener isolation, content preservation, and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified.
actions_performed: Created and enabled inventory-status.service on node1 for the supplied application.
Generated a dedicated RSA tunnel credential on node2 and configured a restricted SSH account on node1.
Created and enabled inventory-tunnel.service on node2 with keepalives and automatic restart.
Verified both listeners bind only to loopback and peer-node direct access is blocked.
Interrupted the live SSH session and confirmed automatic tunnel recreation.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.
Preserved RHEL 7.9, kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64, the application, and status document.

evidence.requirement: Persistent loopback SSH tunnel and endpoint
evidence.summary: The restricted SSH account permits only 127.0.0.1:9081; node2’s enabled tunnel listens at 127.0.0.1:9082 and returns the supplied status document.

evidence.requirement: No direct access for other cluster hosts
evidence.summary: Both ports bind only to 127.0.0.1, while peer access through node IPs is blocked before and after restarts.
The healthy tunnel at PID 2220 was interrupted; systemd recreated it as PID 2293 and restored the endpoint without manual recreation.

evidence.requirement: Supplied application and status document preserved
evidence.summary: Original and final SHA-256 hashes match, and the document still reports “Inventory status: ready”.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating system and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 7.9 with kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.
Healthy baseline boot 1a816f1f…; reboot acknowledged; boot changed to 3d7051c4…; SSH, application, data, listener, and dependent tunnel recovered.
Healthy baseline boot bdbfa15c…; reboot acknowledged; boot changed to fbcb95ea…; SSH, tunnel, credential material, listener, document, and hashes recovered.
